name: model-salt
description: Varied results for creative requests that are still exactly what was asked: the model calls model_salt before a creative task and follows what it returns.

interface.shortDescription: Varied, faithful results for creative requests
interface.longDescription: Ask a model for the same thing ten times and you often get the same answer. Model Salt gives the model randomness from outside it: before a creative task it calls model_salt, gets a few things to settle this time, and then does your request as you asked it.
